pages.text: Armor trims are produced with a $(thing)Trim Material$() and a $(l:crafting/sewing_table)Smithing Template$(). In TFC, all gems, along with Silver, Sterling Silver, Gold, Rose Gold, and Bismuth, can be used as trim materials. Armor trims are purely cosmetic.
